story.title: Israeli Strikes in Gaza Result in Multiple Casualties, Including a Child
story.summary: Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip have reportedly killed at least eight Palestinians, including a four-year-old child. The strikes targeted areas in Khan Younis and Gaza City, with reports indicating that five members of the Hamas-run police were among the deceased. Some sources suggest the death toll may be as high as nine.

timeline_highlights.title: Israeli Strikes in Gaza Result in Seven Deaths and Destruction of Medical Warehouses
timeline_highlights.summary: Israeli military strikes in Gaza have resulted in the deaths of seven individuals and the destruction of medical supply warehouses. The Gaza Health Ministry condemned the attacks, which occurred amid ongoing uncertainty regarding a disarmament deal with Hamas. Reports indicate that the strikes targeted warehouses near a hospital, which were believed to be storing medical supplies.

timeline_highlights.title: Netanyahu Criticizes UN Delegates Who Walked Out During His Speech
timeline_highlights.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu defended Israel's military actions in his speech at the UN General Assembly, labeling delegates who walked out as 'moral cowards.' He dismissed allegations of genocide and reiterated support for operations in Gaza and other regions. The walkout occurred as he addressed the assembly, highlighting tensions surrounding Israel's actions in the Middle East.

event_overview.title: About Gaza Conflict
event_overview.subject: Gaza Conflict
event_overview.summary: The Gaza conflict is the war between Israel and Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups centered on the Gaza Strip, following the Hamas-led attacks in southern Israel on October 7, 2023 and Israel’s ensuing large-scale military campaign. It has involved air, ground and naval operations, rocket fire, hostage-taking, repeated displacement of civilians, and a major humanitarian emergency in Gaza.

facts.label: Start
facts.value: The current war began on October 7, 2023, when Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attacked communities and military sites in southern Israel, killed civilians and security personnel, and took hostages; Israel then began major military operations in Gaza.

facts.label: Location and parties
facts.value: Hostilities are centered on the Gaza Strip and also affect Israel; the principal belligerents are Israel and Hamas, alongside other Palestinian armed groups. Gaza’s civilian population is estimated by UN humanitarian agencies at about 2.1 million people.

facts.label: Humanitarian context
facts.value: The conflict has caused extensive civilian casualties, damage to civilian infrastructure and repeated displacement. UN reporting in August 2026 described continuing military activity across Gaza and severe overcrowding, with much of the population concentrated in less than half of the Strip.

facts.label: International legal framework
facts.value: International humanitarian law governs the conduct of hostilities, including protections for civilians and civilian objects; the UN Security Council has demanded compliance with international law, humanitarian access and hostage releases.

facts.label: International proceedings
facts.value: The conflict is also the subject of proceedings at the International Court of Justice in South Africa v. Israel under the Genocide Convention; the case concerns state responsibility and is separate from determining individual criminal liability.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline follows particular reported developments in Gaza during August and September 2026, rather than providing a complete record of the war, its casualties, diplomacy, legal proceedings or events elsewhere in Israel and the occupied Palestinian territory.

related_stories.title: FBI Links North Korea to $6.3 Billion Binance Crypto Heist
related_stories.summary: The FBI has attributed the recent $6.3 billion hack of the cryptocurrency exchange Binance to North Korea, specifically identifying a group known as TraderTraitor as responsible for the cyber attack. This incident is noted as the largest cryptocurrency theft in history. Following the breach, Binance has resumed withdrawals and reported that it has covered approximately 90% of the losses incurred by its users.

related_stories.title: Serbia's Police Chief Arrested for Abuse of Office Following Election
related_stories.summary: Marko Kricak, the police chief of Belgrade, has been arrested on allegations of abusing his office. He is accused of suppressing and manipulating an investigation into a gangland murder. Prosecutors have stated that this arrest is not connected to the recent electoral defeat of Aleksandar Vucic.

related_stories.title: France Launches Attempted Murder Investigation Following Protest Violence
related_stories.summary: An attempted murder investigation has been initiated by Paris prosecutors after petrol bombs were thrown at police during protests. The incident, which included footage of an officer on fire, has drawn significant public outrage. During the protests and Halloween night, France reported 779 arrests, a decrease compared to previous weekends.
